name: GitHub
summary: Reads your GitHub repositories and their issues. Read-only: it can't push, comment or change anything.

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.where: github.com, Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens: give it read-only access to the repositories you choose.

setup: On github.com open Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, and press Generate new token.
Choose the repositories, and under Repository permissions set Contents and Issues to Read-only. Nothing else is needed.
Copy the token and paste it into the Personal access token field here, then press Test.

operations.name: who_am_i
operations.description: The account the token belongs to.

params.name: owner
params.description: The account or organisation, such as octocat.
